name: v0.9.0
body: ## Overview This release adds OCP FP8 E4M3 quantization support, a new `flash_attn_ext_rows` op that makes the unified KV cache efficient for multi-sequence inference, and a generic batched tensor copy API. Four new architectures are supported (Clover, Limite, Metis-1.6 and Mistral Large 4), audio generation and transcription expand with Chatterbox TTS, Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe and predefined Pocket TTS voices, and the Gemma 4 E2B/E4B models get major prefill optimizations. `ggml` is updated to v0.29.0, bringing FP8 E4M3, flash attention rows, NCCL-based multi-node tensor parallelism and performance work across the CPU, CUDA, SYCL, Metal, Vulkan, OpenCL and Hexagon backends. The server and UI receive a round of fixes and refinements. ### Highlights - Quant: OCP FP8 E4M3 tensor type (saturating mode) with conversion helpers and a new ftype ([#27512](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27512)) - llama: `flash_attn_ext_rows` - more efficient unified KV for multi-seq, restoring non-unified KV prefill performance ([#29510](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29510)) - ggml: batched tensor copy API (`ggml_backend_tensor_copy_n`/`set_n`/`get_n`) superseding the `_2d` API, implemented for Metal and CUDA ([#30881](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30881)) - For a 3rd year in a row, `llama.cpp` is a featured repo in the [Github Octoverse report](https://github.blog/news-insights/octoverse/octoverse-commits-pushes-reach-new-highs-in-2026-as-developers-build-with-agents/): ### API changes - llama.h: add `LLAMA_FTYPE_MOSTLY_F8_E4M3` ([#27512](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27512)) - mtmd.h: add `MTMD_GEN_AUDIO_TYPE_CHATTERBOX` and `n_voices` to `mtmd_gen_audio_info` ([#30993](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30993)) - mtmd.h: add predefined-voice APIs: `mtmd_gen_audio_voice_name()`, `mtmd_gen_audio_get_voice()`, `mtmd_gen_state_set_ref()` ([#30993](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30993)) - mtmd.h: add `mtmd_bitmap_is_voice()` and `mtmd_gen_audio_read_tensor()` ([#30993](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30993)) - mtmd.h: add `MTMD_VIDEO_TEMPLATE_QWEN3VL` video prompt template ([#31619](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31619)) - server: `GET /props` reports the model's predefined TTS `voices`; the TTS endpoint accepts predefined voice names ([#30993](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30993)) - server: `/v1/responses` now merges `extra_params` (seed, min_p, ...) into the converted chat-completions response ([#30959](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30959)) ### New models - Clover-35B-A3B-Preview diffusion model, AR mode ([#31306](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31306)) - Limite 1B - Violetto ([#29433](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29433)) - Metis-1.6 (Praxis ~2.9B and Logos ~10.2B): hybrid Mamba-2 / GQA attention with fixed-depth recurrence and LatentMoE ([#31134](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31134)) - Mistral Large 4 ([#31376](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31376)) ### Core changes - gemma4: graph optimizations with massive prefill gains for E2B and E4B ([#31356](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31356)); create `token_embd` before the tied output in gemma3n and gemma4 ([#31394](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31394)) - LFM3: enable NVFP4 GGUFs ([#31608](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31608)), enable tensor split ([#31431](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31431)), quantize the audio codec decoder ([#31386](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31386)) - spec dec: save and restore MTP hidden state in context checkpoints ([#30141](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30141)) and record LFM3 layer inputs ([#31598](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31598)) - dflash: copy hidden features via device copies ([#31506](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31506)); qwen4exp: write the conv state tail without an intermediate cont ([#31443](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31443)) - model loading: reuse the tensor staging buffer and skip the direct-IO bounce buffer ([#31321](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31321)) - kv-cache: keep Hadamard rotation constants on the GPU ([#31073](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31073)) and fix attention tensor rotation in layers with shared KV ([#31406](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31406)) - kv-cache: never return 0 `kv_rows` for sequences without cells ([#31570](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31570)) and refuse rollbacks past the snapshots of the last ubatch ([#31368](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31368)) - Gemma4 MTP assistant: follow `ctx_other` devices and flash-attention setting ([#31635](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31635)); DSV4: remove simple batch splitting ([#31300](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31300)) - chat: strip the qwen3-coder think block with `reasoning_format none` ([#31380](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31380)) and end reasoning budget forcing on a prompt end tag ([#31374](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31374)) - chat: allow a constraint type after the gpt-oss final channel ([#31556](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31556)); common: fix `-hf` tag matching inside longer quant names ([#31620](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31620)) and bound control vector layer indices ([#31336](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31336)) - tools: reject mismatched shards in GGUF split merge ([#31579](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31579)), fix `imatrix --nextn` crash ([#31522](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31522)), fix `gguf-py` `np_roundf` dropping the sign ([#31310](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31310)) - vendor: miniaudio 0.11.26 ([#31459](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31459)) and cpp-httplib 0.64.0 ([#31400](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31400)); embed an app manifest in all Windows executables ([#31329](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31329)) ### Multi-modality changes - add Chatterbox TTS support ([#30993](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30993)) - add Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe support: offline transcription in 40 languages with prompt context and speaker attribution ([#31471](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31471)) - Pocket TTS: support predefined voices without voice cloning ([#31429](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31429)) - accurate support for the qwen3-vl video prompt format ([#31619](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31619)) - resize Gemma 4 images without letterbox padding ([#30922](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30922)) and fix InternVL CLS token order ([#30886](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30886)) ### Server changes - cap shared decision prefixes at the first output ([#30710](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30710)) - restore the speculative checkpoint for drafts longer than `n_rs_seq` ([#31350](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31350)) ### UI changes - add MCP group checkboxes in the tools settings ([#31303](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31303)) and request persistent storage on startup ([#31299](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31299)) - keep chats at the bottom until the reader scrolls up ([#31311](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31311)) and show the submit button when the input has content ([#31324](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31324)) - reveal the collapsed sidebar from its logo ([#31307](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31307)) and align alert dialog styling ([#31312](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31312)) - keep queued steering messages in their own conversation ([#31304](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31304)) and show an interrupted state for tool calls that never returned ([#31314](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31314)) - disable model deletion the server would refuse ([#31305](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31305)) and prefer a loading model in pre-selection ([#31326](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31326)) - add a Playwright harness for recording demo videos ([#31318](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31318)) and run local browser tests in installed Chrome ([#31596](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31596)) ### ggml changes - [v0.29.0](https://github.com/ggml-org/ggml/releases/tag/v0.29.0): ggml v0.29.0 adds an OCP FP8 E4M3 tensor type, a new `ggml_flash_attn_ext_rows` op where each query slice attends to its own list of K/V rows, a batched tensor copy API, and initial support for multi-node tensor parallelism through a new multi-process communicator interface. Core improvements include bounding tensor views by the bytes their strides reach, zero-copy GGUF export of host-buffer tensors, and `vm_allocate`-based allocations on Apple platforms. Performance work spans all major backends: new SVE kernels in the CPU backend, DPAS flash attention for quantized KV in SYCL, fused MoE MMQ in CUDA, faster MXFP4 mat-vec in Metal, split-K tuning in Vulkan, and a large expansion of quantized GEMM/GEMV coverage in OpenCL. The Hexagon backend gains support for several new ops, including the lightning indexer, top-k mask, conv2d and upscale. ## Assets **Nightly build:** [b12110](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/releases/tag/b12110) ## More info - [Releases and versioning of `ggml-org` projects](https://github.com/ggml-org/ggml/discussions/1579) ## Changelog
